extra_attrs.description: List of XML attribute key-value pairs (e.g., for xmlns, xsi:schemaLocation). Each item is a flat object with 'key' and 'value'.

creation_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for config creation date.

modification_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for config last modification date.

version.description: FreeFileSync application version used to create config.

config_version.description: Config format version (must match FreeFileSync version).

folder_pairs.description: List of folder pairs to sync. Each item is a pair of paths and optional filters.

comparison_method.description: Method used to compare files: 'timestamp', 'size', or 'content'.

binary_comparison.description: Enable byte-by-byte comparison for files with identical timestamp/size.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logging goes to stdout/console.

max_parallel_files.description: Maximum number of files processed in parallel during comparison/sync.

max_parallel_ops.description: Maximum number of parallel I/O operations per device.

email_recipients.description: List of email addresses to receive sync logs (Business/Donation Edition only).
